2026-1.lead: Russell won the opener from pole, but only after a virtual safety car split the strategies
2026-1.note: He lost the lead to Leclerc on the opening lap, and it changed hands seven times inside ten laps as drivers learned what the new energy rules did to a defending car — Russell's battery was short of charge exactly when he needed it. The race turned when Isack Hadjar pulled off: both Mercedes pitted under the virtual safety car, both Ferraris stayed out, and that was the afternoon. Antonelli followed him home for a Mercedes one-two. Oscar Piastri never started, spinning into the barriers on his way to the grid at his home race.

2026-2.lead: Antonelli's first Grand Prix win came in his second start, at nineteen
2026-2.note: He had already become the youngest polesitter in the sport's history on the Saturday, and converting it made him the second-youngest race winner. It was not a clean weekend for anyone else: four cars failed to reach the grid at all, Norris and Piastri among them, and a safety car restart shuffled the order behind. Russell recovered from a poor restart to take second and hold the championship lead. The race behind was a Ferrari argument — Hamilton and Leclerc ran wheel to wheel for several laps, Hamilton coming out of it with his first podium for the team.

2026-3.lead: Antonelli lost the lead at the start and won it back in the pit lane
2026-3.note: Wheelspin off the line dropped him from pole to sixth on the opening lap while Piastri swept through to lead, and for twenty laps this did not look like a Mercedes race. Then Oliver Bearman crashed heavily at Spoon on lap 22, moments after Piastri, Russell, Norris and Leclerc had all stopped. The safety car handed Antonelli a cheap pit stop and the lead, and he controlled it from there to finish over thirteen seconds clear. He left Suzuka as the youngest driver ever to lead the drivers' championship, and the first teenager to do it.

2026-4.lead: Three races, three poles, three wins — Antonelli became the first driver to open a career that way
2026-4.note: It was not serene. He locked up alongside Verstappen into the first corner, went across the run-off to avoid Leclerc, then had to steer around Verstappen's spinning Red Bull. Separate crashes for Hadjar and Gasly brought the safety car inside six laps, and the lead passed between four drivers before it settled. Norris finished three seconds back and said McLaren should have stopped first; he and Piastri gave the team its first double podium of the year. Leclerc was running third with two laps left when he spun on his own.

2026-5.lead: Russell had sprint pole, the sprint win, Grand Prix pole and the lead, and none of it survived lap thirty
2026-5.note: The two Mercedes had spent the first stint trading the lead and once banged wheels at the final chicane, Antonelli briefly going ahead off the track and being told to give it back. It was shaping into the race of the season when Russell's car simply lost power. A virtual safety car followed, most of the field pitted, and Antonelli came out with a lead nobody was going to take off him. Behind, Hamilton produced his best afternoon in Ferrari red, taking second from Verstappen with a clean move into Turn 1 six laps from home.

2026-6.lead: Antonelli led every lap of a race that had to be stopped and restarted, and became the youngest Monaco winner
2026-6.note: It was his fifth win in a row. Verstappen was effectively out before the start, rolling off the front row with an engine problem that both Ferraris had passed by the first corner. Seven cars retired. Antonelli had built a lead of nearly thirty seconds when two late safety cars arrived for separate crashes at the final corner — Stroll first, then Leclerc as the field prepared to go again — and the race was suspended altogether while the barriers were repaired. Russell's weekend ended twelfth after a drive-through penalty in the closing laps.

2026-7.lead: Hamilton's first win for Ferrari ended Mercedes' clean sweep of the season
2026-7.note: Russell had pole and the lead, and Ferrari beat him with strategy rather than pace: a three-stop that looked expensive until Fernando Alonso's Aston Martin failed, the virtual safety car arrived, and Hamilton took a free stop out of it. He came back on fresher tyres and went past. It was his 106th Grand Prix victory and his first in 686 days, and at 41 he became the oldest winner since Jack Brabham in 1970. Antonelli had just cleared Russell for second when his car died with an electrical failure. The podium was the first all-British one since 1968.

2026-8.lead: Russell led every lap from pole and still finished with two cars inside two seconds of him
2026-8.note: Verstappen recovered from a qualifying crash to work his way to second and spent the final stint closing on the Mercedes, only to find himself under attack from behind as Antonelli arrived in the last few laps — the three covered by under two seconds at the flag. Russell did it in brutal Spielberg heat with a failed drinks system, and it was his first win since the season opener in Melbourne after a run in which his own team-mate had taken five. Cadillac's afternoon ended early with brake problems on both cars.

2026-9.lead: Leclerc took the lead at the first corner and won his first British Grand Prix by four tenths
2026-9.note: Antonelli had pole and had won the sprint the day before, and lost the race on the run to Turn 1 as both Ferraris went by. He fought back past Hamilton around the outside of Copse and ran long to build a tyre advantage, then reported on lap 41 that something was broken — a failed left wheel shield that cost him two more stops and any hope of a podium. Verstappen's crash at Stowe seven laps from the end brought the safety car that compressed everything, and the race never went green again.

2026-10.lead: Antonelli lost the lead twice at Spa and took it back both times, the second with a pass on the Kemmel Straight
2026-10.note: Verstappen went around the outside of him through Eau Rouge on the opening lap but could not make it stick. The bigger threat was Ferrari's pit wall, which timed a stop well enough to put Leclerc in front, and Antonelli spent a dozen laps closing the gap before going by on lap 34. He then had to do it all again through a safety car restart, holding on to win by under two seconds. Russell's race lasted a single lap: contact with Hamilton at Turn 6 left him in the gravel, and Hamilton took a five-second penalty for it.

2026-11.lead: Norris ended Mercedes' run of ten straight poles by twelve thousandths, then had to win the race twice
2026-11.note: He ran wide at Turn 2 on the opening lap and handed the lead to Piastri, and McLaren declined to intervene while he sat in his team-mate's mirrors for half the afternoon. The order resolved itself when Piastri, just out of his second stop, made contact with Carlos Sainz; he retired later. Norris finished fifteen seconds clear for McLaren's first win of the season, his first since becoming champion and his first with the number one on the car. Verstappen's second place came from Red Bull spotting that the soft tyre would last a 29-lap stint.

2026-12.lead: The last scheduled Dutch Grand Prix was red-flagged after one lap and won on a long middle stint
2026-12.note: Verstappen lost the car at the banked final corner on the opening lap and hit the barriers hard, stopping the race in front of his home crowd; he was unhurt. Antonelli took the lead from Norris at the standing restart and held it for most of the afternoon. Norris beat him by running his penultimate stint several laps longer, rejoining behind both Antonelli and an out-of-sequence Hamilton, and clearing them both on lap 54 before two virtual safety cars tested the lead he had built. It was his second win in a row and his second at Zandvoort.
